name: Husqvarna 125i
blurb: 10″ and 12″ bars on 1/4″ mini chain, .043″ gauge, 60 and 68 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide.
intro: The 125i is a battery rear-handle saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) lists two combinations, both 1/4″ mini pitch, .043″ gauge, file 9/64″: a 10″ bar with 60 drive links (SP11G X-Cut 548823260, bar Laminate 548823360) and a 12″ bar with 68 drive links (SP11G X-Cut 548823268, bar Laminate 548823368). This is not 3/8″ low-profile chain.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 10″ setup with bar Laminate 548823360 and chain SP11G X-Cut 548823260. The guide's pitch column says 1/4 mini. File size 9/64″.
Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 12″ setup with bar Laminate 548823368 and chain SP11G X-Cut 548823268. The guide's pitch column says 1/4 mini. File size 9/64″.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027): certified/approved bar and chain combinations, with bar length, pitch, gauge, drive links, file size, bar part and chain part

sources_note: Husqvarna Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover dated 2027, PDF read 9 Nov 2026 (https://media.husqvarnagroup.com/original/DI-328359.pdf). Every row restates that saw's entry in the guide.
